RETAIL INSTALLMENT CONTRACT

This retail installment contract is between Lakeshore Motors LLC ("Seller") and the individual buyer identified below ("Buyer"). Seller may assign this contract to a holder.

1. Price and Payment

1.1 Buyer shall pay the cash price, the finance charge and the other amounts itemized in the payment schedule.

1.2 Buyer grants Seller a security interest in the goods purchased.

2. Holder Notice

NOTICE ANY HOLDER OF THIS CONSUMER CREDIT CONTRACT IS SUBJECT TO ALL CLAIMS AND DEFENCES WHICH THE DEBTOR COULD ASSERT AGAINST THE SELLER OF GOODS OR SERVICES OBTAINED PURSUANT HERETO OR WITH THE PROCEEDS HEREOF. RECOVERY HEREUNDER BY THE DEBTOR SHALL NOT EXCEED THE AMOUNTS PAID BY THE DEBTOR HEREUNDER.

3. Warranties

3.1 Seller hereby disclaims the implied warranty of merchantability and the implied warranty of fitness for a particular purpose with respect to the goods sold under this contract.

3.2 The goods are sold as is, with all faults.

4. Miscellaneous

4.1 This contract is governed by the laws of the State of Ohio.
